translations.en: And ʿUqbah ibn Khālid asked him:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَعَاهُ رَجُلٌ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَسَهَا فَأَجَابَهُ بِحَاجَتِهِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ

translations.en: About a man whom another man called while he was performing salat (prayer), so he became distracted and responded to his need—what should he do?
He said: "He should continue with his salat (prayer)."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who is distracted during salat (prayer) and responds when called. The ruling states that he should continue his salat (prayer), indicating that this lapse does not require him to break it.
en.seo_question: If someone responds to a person while praying out of distraction, should he continue his salat (prayer)?
